kurz: Risotto turns creamy without cream: stirring releases starch from the rice grain, and at the end butter and cheese bind everything into an [[emulsion|emulsion]].
bild_im_kopf: Like pearls that release their own paste.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Sweat the rice in fat until translucent
schluesselmomente.warum: The grains are sealed on the outside and cook more evenly.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Add hot stock bit by bit and stir
schluesselmomente.warum: Friction releases starch from the surface, which thickens the liquid.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Take it off the heat while the core still has a little bite
schluesselmomente.warum: The rice keeps cooking in the heat.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Vigorously stir in cold butter and parmesan (mantecare)
schluesselmomente.warum: Fat, starch and cheese combine into a creamy emulsion.
